name: Arcane Disciple
body:
The children of magic, descendants of scholar families, those who breathe magic like others breathe air, become arcane disciples.

Requirements

To qualify to become an arcane disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Feats: Any two metamagic and/or item creation feats.
Skills: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks.
Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level arcane spells. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the arcane bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the arcane bloodline.
Class Skills

The arcane disciple’s class skills are Craft (Int), Fly (Dex), Knowledge (all) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perform (Cha), Profession (Int), Spellcraft (Int), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d6.

Table 8: Arcane Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+0	+0	+1	Arcane blood, arcane enigma, detect magic, natural armor increase +1	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Dex +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
3rd	+1	+1	+1	+2	Arcane enigma	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
4th	+2	+1	+1	+2	Ability boost (Dex +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
5th	+2	+2	+2	+3	Arcane enigma, bloodline feat, greater detect magic	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
6th	+3	+2	+2	+3	Ability boost (Int +2)	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
7th	+3	+2	+2	+4	Arcane enigma, natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
8th	+4	+3	+3	+4	Ability boost (Wis +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
9th	+4	+3	+3	+5	Arcane enigma	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
10th	+5	+3	+3	+5	Arcane enigma, arcane sight	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the arcane disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Arcane disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

When a new arcane disciple level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in an arcane spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. He does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if he is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting.

If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming an arcane disciple, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Arcane Blood: An arcane disciple adds his level to his sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from his bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with his arcane disciple levels to determine his bloodline powers. If he does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, he instead gains bloodline powers of the arcane sorcerer bloodline, using his arcane disciple level as his sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless he possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Arcane Enigma: At every odd level, and again at 10th level, an arcane disciple unveils an enigma of the arcane arts. Each enigma can only be chosen once unless noted otherwise.

Arcane Bolt (Sp)

The arcane disciple gains the arcane bolt ability of the sage sorcerer bloodline, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. If he already possesses arcane bolt through his bloodline, the damage dealt increases to 1d6 points +1/2 his equivalent sorcerer level plus his spellcasting ability bonus.

Arcane Bond (Su)

The arcane disciple gains the arcane bond ability of the arcane sorcerer bloodline, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. If the arcane disciple already has an arcane bond from another class, his arcane disciple levels stack with levels in that class for the purpose of determining the abilities of his familiar or bonded item.

If he possesses arcane bond through the arcane blood power of this prestige class, he gains instead Improved Familiar or Improved Bonded Item (see below) as a bonus feat, even if his caster level is not yet high enough.

Bardic Knowledge (Ex)

The arcane disciple gains a bard’s bardic knowledge ability, using his arcane disciple levels as his bard levels. If the arcane disciple already possesses bardic knowledge, his arcane disciple and bard levels stack for the purpose of using this ability.

Bonus Feat: The arcane disciple gains a bonus bloodline feat. If the disciple belongs to a class that grants bonus feats as a class feature, he can instead gain a bonus feat of that type, stacking his arcane disciple levels and his levels in that class for the purpose of meeting the feat’s prerequisites.

Caster’s Scourge (Ex)

The arcane disciple gains the caster’s scourge ability of the arcane bloodrager bloodline, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the number of extra attacks of opportunity he gains doubles.

Continued Studies: Choose one of the following class features: alarm sense, animal guide, arcane school, arcanist exploits, bardic performance, cabalist talents, devoted mystic, know-it-all, magus arcana, mystic bolts, raging song, spill blood, summon monster, warlock talents, witch hexes, or wizard discoveries.

The character adds his arcane disciple class levels to his effective class level in one class of his choice for the purpose of determining the effects of the chosen class feature. This does not grant additional abilities. This enigma can be selected more than once, but the arcane disciple must select a different class feature each time.

Disruptive Bloodrage (Su)

The arcane disciple gains the disruptive bloodrage ability of the arcane bloodrager bloodline, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. If he already possesses disruptive bloodrage through his bloodline, the DC to cast spells defensively increases by an additional +2 for enemies into his threatened area. An arcane disciple must have the bloodrage class ability to select this enigma.

Extra Arcane Discovery: The arcane disciple gains one arcane discovery. He must meet that discovery’s prerequisites, if any. An arcane disciple must have access to arcane discoveries to select this enigma. It can be selected more than once.

Extra Arcanist Exploit: The arcane disciple gains one arcanist exploit (or a greater exploit if his equivalent arcanist level is high enough). He must meet that exploit’s prerequisites, if any. An arcane disciple must have the arcanist exploit class feature to select this enigma. It can be selected more than once.

Extra Bardic Masterpiece: The arcane disciple gains one bardic masterpiece (or skaldic saga). He must meet that masterpiece’s prerequisites, if any. An arcane disciple must have access to bardic masterpieces skaldic sagas to select this enigma. It can be selected more than once.

Extra Evolution: The arcane disciple’s eidolon gains 1 extra point in its evolution pool. An arcane disciple must have the eidolon class feature to select this enigma. It can be selected more than once.

Extra Hex: The arcane disciple gains one witch hex (or a major hex if his equivalent witch level is high enough). An arcane disciple must have the witch hex class feature to select this enigma. It can be selected more than once.

Extra Magus Arcana: The arcane disciple gains one magus arcana. He must meet that arcana’s prerequisites, if any. An arcane disciple must have the magus arcana class feature to select this enigma. It can be selected more than once.

Lore Master (Su)

The arcane disciple gains a bard’s lore master ability, using his arcane disciple levels as his bard levels. If the disciple already possesses lore master, his arcane disciple and bard levels stack for the purpose of using this ability. An arcane disciple must be at least 5th level to select this enigma.

New Arcana (Ex)

The arcane disciple gains the new arcana ability of the arcane sorcerer bloodline, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, he gains instead 1 new spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list for every level of arcane spells he is capable of casting. An arcane disciple must be at least 3rd level to select this enigma.

School Power (Ex)

The arcane disciple gains the school power ability of the arcane sorcerer bloodline, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the bonus on save DCs for spells from the selected school he casts increases to +4. An arcane disciple must be at least 9th level to select this enigma.

Spell-Like Ability (Sp)

The arcane disciple gains one 1st- or 2nd-level spell of his choice from the wizard/sorcerer list (that does not attack a creature or deal damage) as a spell-like ability that he can use 3 times per day at his arcane caster level. If the arcane disciple possesses the arcane bloodrager bloodline, he can use this spell-like ability with arcane bloodrage, greater arcane bloodrage, and true arcane bloodrage. This enigma can be selected more than once.

Spell Kenning (Su)

The arcane disciple gains a skald’s spell kenning ability, using his arcane disciple levels as his skald levels. If the arcane disciple already possesses spell kenning, his arcane disciple and skald levels stack for the purpose of using this ability.

Detect Magic (Sp)

An arcane disciple can detect magic at will, as the spell. At 5th level, this functions instead as greater detect magic, and at 10th level, as arcane sight.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, an arcane disciple gains an eldritch protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to his natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As his body becomes more accustomed to channel magical energies, an arcane disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 8: Arcane Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement

Bloodline Feat: Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, an arcane disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer arcane bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager arcane bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one he is advancing with his level progression.
